text:
Nia: hey all just realized i never got an insurance ID card after enrolling. did i miss a step?
Leo (People Ops): welcome Nia! cards are mailed normally; digital card appears in insurer app once enrollment finalizes (24-48 hrs). what carrier did you pick?
Nia: BlueNorth PPO (default). the enrollment page said complete but no app link.
BenefitsBot: Enrollment status for employee 18245: pending verification by carrier. Expected confirmation within 48 hours.
Nia: ah okay. if it's delayed, can i still see a provider? i have a dentist appointment tomorrow.
Leo (People Ops): yes y default providers accept the member ID or a temporary letter. DM me your appt time and i'll generate an eligibility letter you can show.
Nia: sending details in DM. quick extra Q: i elected HSA but my partner has an FSA at their job. does that affect my HSA contribution limit?
Leo (People Ops): short: partner's FSA doesn't block your HSA unless they cover you on a non-HSA-eligible plan. if you're on the HDHP HSA plan, you're fine. if unsure, paste partner plan name here and benefits can confirm.
Nia: partner's plan is "MediPlus Standard" and it lists family coverage.
BenefitsBot: Note: if you are covered by another non-HDHP medical plan, you may be ineligible for HSA contributions. Please contact benefits@redwood.ai for verification.
Nia: thanks. last one: Payroll shows direct deposit active, but the first paycheck date seems off. who to ping?
Payroll Team: Hi Nia we see direct deposit on file. First payroll run for new hires with start date 2026-03-20 is 2026-04-01. If you need an earlier check, request a one-time manual pay at payroll@redwood.ai.
Nia: perfect, appreciate the help everyone :relaxed:
Leo (People Ops): np! I'll DM the eligibility letter and loop benefits for the HSA check.
